ratings_why.fun: Lighting one end and watching the knot go off down the zigzag is a great board to grow, and spend versus hold is a real choice; cascades while recruiting take some working out.
ratings_why.distinct: A threshold counter that spills along the touching line is new for Bramble and for auto-battlers, though growth along touching runs is close to Hedgerow ground.

verdict_why: Two wording fixes, the Blurt leftover rule and when 'holding 2 Gossip' is checked, are needed before the cards read cleanly; the design itself is ready.

points.text: Blurt says it 'clears its Gossip', then that 'Gossip left over stays', and the risks still list leftover as open. Say it once: Gossip that arrives after the 3rd stays on the unit.
Ilse the Minute-Taker and Old Gundel say 'holding 2 Gossip', but pips change mid-chain. Say when it is checked, e.g. 'each unit holding 2 Gossip before any is given'.
The Bean-Counter and Wall-Runner count Blurts in a chain; a running chain count on screen would make both readable at a glance.
Let Granary Huddler and Taster Wendelin come in with 1 Gossip, so the first Blurt lands by turn 2 and a new player sees the rule early.

standouts.why: Little Fips: the story is the rule, the one who sees the far end throws news to the far end. Reads at once.
Speaker Brotkrume: never holds the floor, so Blurts at 1 and hands everything on. A clear hub with perfect flavour.
The Bad Omen: rumour spread into the enemy's board, hurting each one that panics. Plain text, strong woodland-folklore feel.

weakest.why: Wall-Runner: a generic Discover reward with no council or knot flavour in what it does.
Cold-Shed Tangle: summoning tokens is generic, and it has two separate caps to track.
The Thirty-Two: you have to read every other card to know what it does, so it can't be read at a glance.

flags.note: Golden Thirty-Two with a golden Bellringer under the King uses every text many times a turn; stats are unbounded.
The Piper on a fully loaded board can give seven attacks before the enemy acts.
When 'holding 2 Gossip' is checked during a chain is not stated; same for Old Gundel.
